roles.heroLead: The tile you can see was never the waterproofing — the bonded membrane behind it is. On a Skykomish Valley property, that hidden layer separates a shower that outlives your mortgage from a framing repair priced like a good used truck. We build the full assembly, flood it for 24 hours, photograph the proof, then open the first box of tile.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Monroe, WA?
roles.costP1: Around Monroe, plan on $14–$26 per square foot installed for tile — that folds in the tile itself, setting materials, substrate prep and labor, with labor alone starting at $11/sq ft. A tub-shower surround typically runs $3,200–$6,800, a bathroom floor near 45 sq ft runs $900–$1,600, and a complete bathroom with shower, floor and niche lands at $6,500–$14,000.
roles.costP2: What moves the bill isn't the sticker on the box — it's the format. A $4 mosaic sheet can out-cost a $12 large-format porcelain plank on install day, because the hours go into cuts and grout joints, not into whatever the tile aisle charged.
roles.costNote: Ranges reflect Monroe-area installs as of August 2026 — tile, materials and labor together. The number that matters is the written one from your free on-site estimate.
roles.layersLead: Bottom to top, seven layers. When a Sky Valley shower fails and we get the call, one of them was skipped — nearly always the membrane, a few hundred dollars saved on day one that turns into a five-figure tear-out later.
roles.whyP1: Leaks work quietly. Water slips past grout, wicks into the substrate, and surfaces a couple of winters later as a spongy hallway floor or a stain on the ceiling under the bathroom. By that point you're not fixing tile — you're replacing framing, subfloor and drywall, then tiling all over again.
roles.whyP2: Waterproofing runs roughly a tenth of what a shower costs. Leaving it out is the priciest shortcut a bathroom remodel can take.
roles.scopeIntro: These are starting numbers — tile format, substrate shape and layout complexity all push them around. Your real figure gets written down on site, free.

roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Monroe, WA?
roles.faqA1: Expect $14 to $26 per square foot installed for tile in Monroe once the tile, setting materials, substrate prep and labor are all counted — labor by itself starts at $11 per square foot. A standard tub-shower surround comes in between $3,200 and $6,800, while a full bathroom with shower, floor and niche generally totals $6,500 to $14,000. Format matters more than the price tag: mosaic sheets and large-format planks both take considerably more labor per square foot than a plain 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Monroe?
roles.faqA2: Figure $3,200 to $6,800 for a standard alcove shower in Monroe — demo, bonded waterproofing, a pre-sloped pan or base, the tile itself, a niche and grout all inside that number. Benches, curbless entries, steam setups and full-height stone climb past it. Waterproofing itself is about a tenth of the total, and it heads off the one failure that runs to five figures.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Every time. Behind our tile sits a bonded waterproofing system — never bare cement board and thinset. That means a base with pre-slope, an ANSI A118.10 membrane — sheet or liquid — carried up the walls, seams, corners and pipe penetrations sealed, and a 24-hour flood test we photograph before tile goes on. Grout and tile shed water; only the membrane actually keeps it away from your framing.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Four to six working days covers a typical Monroe bathroom: demolition and dust protection first, then substrate work and waterproofing with the 24-hour flood test, one to two days of setting, and a final day of grout, silicone and trim. The shower then needs 24 hours of grout cure before its first use. A floor on its own usually wraps in a day or two.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: For anything wet or walked on hard, porcelain: it's denser, takes in under 0.5% water and shrugs off chips. Ceramic earns its keep on walls and backsplashes at a lower price. On Monroe jobs — mudroom, entry or shower floor — porcelain goes underfoot every time, and ceramic or glass does the decorating up on the walls.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes — and on a Sky Valley winter morning it's the upgrade people thank us for. An electric radiant mat under the tile adds roughly $11 to $16 per square foot installed, thermostat included. It lies over an uncoupling membrane, gets resistance-tested before the tile is set and again after, and takes its own dedicated circuit. The catch: it only pencils out while the floor is already open.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Nine times out of ten, yes. Demo and haul-away run from $3.50 per square foot, and pulling the old tile is the only honest look at your subfloor — rot, movement and door-height issues all show themselves there. Going over existing tile can work on a flat, solid, well-bonded floor, but it raises the finished height and buries problems better caught at demo than after the grout is in.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Monroe?
roles.faqA8: In Monroe, a typical 30 square foot kitchen backsplash lands between $1,100 and $2,200 installed, with cuts at every outlet, trimmed edges and grout matched to the counter. Herringbone patterns, mosaic sheets, a framed detail over the range and slab-look porcelain run to the ceiling all push toward the top, since layout and cutting eat the hours.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Frequently, yes. Repair and regrout work starts at $8 per square foot — the right answer when grout has stained or crumbled, an impact cracked a tile or two, or shower corners need the old grout dug out and swapped for silicone. But tile that sounds hollow, tiles releasing in a pattern, or a wall with any give means the substrate is gone, and patching only rents you a few months. We tell you which situation you've got before any quote.
roles.faqQ10: Which Monroe neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: All of Monroe and the surrounding valley — Downtown Monroe, the Fryelands, Lake Tye, Woods Creek, Chain Lake, Florence Acres, the Tualco Valley, High Rock, Three Lakes, Lord Hill and Echo Lake — along with Maltby, Sultan, Startup, Snohomish, Duvall and the rest of the Sky Valley and Snohomish County.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: Tile installation from OC Flooring carries a 2-year workmanship warranty — longer than our carpet coverage, because a bad tile job surfaces in year two rather than week two. When we install a manufacturer's complete bonded waterproofing assembly, their warranty stacks on top of ours, and the membrane and flood test photos go in your file so the documentation exists if the house ever changes hands.
